newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures slip in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures slip in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were lower across the board in the after-hours session on Monday, pressured by profit-taking, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 yen to 0.8 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark April was 0.3 yen lower at 139.7 yen.
Volume was 12,346 lots. During the day, the market settled mixed after drifting in directionless trade.

"Market players were divided over near-term direction. The yen's weaker tendency and the steady Thai rubber offer prices to Japan were positive for the market, while ample rubber stocks still cast a shadow on the market," one trader said.
